bio: From cinema and TV series to K-pop and food, Korean culture is big in France! Kwon is depicted by a trendy decor with a minimalist, industrial feel and offers a menu of Korean staples like barbecue and bibimbap. The lineup of emblematic side dishes stars the ubiquitous kimchi, crunchy beans with a smoky flavour, caramelised lotus flower or cucumber with chilli. Generous, fresh fare at eater-friendly prices!...
